## How many checked bags can I bring on Economy Saver?
Economy Saver includes one checked bag up to 23 kg. Extra bags cost 45 USD each when added online.

## What happens if my bag is delayed?
Report it at the airport desk within 24 hours. SkyDesk reimburses essentials up to 100 USD per day for up to 5 days.
